summary: Prabodh Chandra Bagchi was an Indologist, Sinologist, and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Krishnagar Government College, University of Calcutta, and University of Paris under Sylvain Lévi. He held posts at Calcutta, Peking University, and Visva-Bharati University.
Pragati Sahni is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy who studied under Damien Keown. She has served as a Lecturer at the University of Delhi.

Prahlad Pradhan was an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar educated at Patna University and Visva-Bharati University. He served as a professor at Utkal University, Principal at Gangadhar Meher University, and held posts at Ravenshaw College and Visva-Bharati.

Pramod Chandra (1930–2016) was an art historian and Indologist who earned his PhD from the University of Mumbai. He worked at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya and held professorships at the University of Chicago and Harvard University.
Prasarn Lao-areun is a scholar of philosophy and Indology who studied under Viroj Inthanon and earned a PhD from the University of Mysore.

Pratap Chandra Chunder (1919–2008) worked in history, archaeology, and Indology. He was educated at the Hindu School, Presidency University, and the University of Calcutta, where he studied under Prabodh Chandra Bagchi.
Pratap Kumar Penumala is a scholar of religious studies and Indology. His career includes serving as a Professor at the University of KwaZulu-Natal and as a Visiting Professor at Colorado College.

Pratapaditya Pal is an art historian, Indologist, and Tibetologist with doctorates from the University of Calcutta and the University of Cambridge. He held curatorial and leadership roles at the Museum of Fine Arts Boston and Los Angeles County Museum of Art.

Prayag Raj Sharma is an Indologist and historian. He served as a professor and Dean of the Centre for Nepal and Asian Studies at Tribhuvan University, and was on the advisory editorial board of Kailash.
Prayoon Mererk is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy who earned his doctorate from the University of Delhi in 1985 under the supervision of Margaret Chatterjee and Mahesh Tiwary.

Prayudh Payutto is a scholar in Buddhist studies and philosophy who completed his bachelor's degree at Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University. He later served as Associate Dean there and held a Tipitaka Acharaya post at Nava Nalanda Mahavihara.

id: P:Prince Peter of Greece and Denmark
summary: Prince Peter of Greece and Denmark (1908–1980) was a scholar in Tibetology, history, and archaeology. He studied at the Lycée Janson-de-Sailly and London School of Economics, and served in the Office of Strategic Services.
Priyavrat Sharma (1920–2008) worked in Indology and history and archaeology. He served as Director at Banaras Hindu University and its Postgraduate Institute of Indian Medicine.

Prods Oktor Skjærvø is a linguist and Iranian and Central Asian studies scholar who studied at the Sorbonne, University of Oslo, and Mainz. He held posts at Mainz, Columbia University, and served as Aga Khan Professor at Harvard University.
Przemysław Szczurek is an Indologist who has held academic posts at Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań and as a Professor of Indology at the University of Breslau.
Pulinbihari Chakravarti was an Indologist and philosophy scholar who studied under Jogendranath Vedantatirtha and Satkari Mookerjee. He served as Curator of Manuscripts at The Asiatic Society.
Punyavijaya (1895–1971) was an Indology and religious studies scholar who studied under Sukhlal Sanghvi and founded the Prakrit Text Society.
Purna Harsha Bajracharya is a scholar in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies who served as Chief Research Officer at the Archaeological Survey of India and the Department of Archaeology.

Purushottam Vishvanath Bapat (1894–1991) was an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at the University of Mumbai and Harvard University. He held positions at Fergusson College, Visva-Bharati University, and the University of Delhi.

Purushottama Bilimoria is a scholar in philosophy, Indology, and religious studies who studied under Shivesh Thakur and completed his PhD at La Trobe University. He has held positions at Deakin University and the University of Melbourne.
